title: Installing Helm & Finding Charts 🔍
description: Get Helm running on your machine and explore the chart ecosystem.

slides.title: Installing the Helm CLI 💻
slides.content:
# Multi‑platform

**macOS**:
```bash
brew install helm
```
**Windows (Chocolatey)**:
```bash
choco install kubernetes-helm
```
**Linux**:
```bash
curl https://raw.githubusercontent.com/helm/helm/main/scripts/get-helm-3 | bash
```

Verify: `helm version`

quizData.question: Which command confirms Helm is correctly installed?
quizData.explanation: `helm version` prints the client version and server connectivity.

slides.title: Helm Repositories 🗄️
slides.content:
## Where charts live

Repositories are HTTP servers serving an `index.yaml` and packaged charts. Common ones:
- **Bitnami**: `https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami`
- **Stable (deprecated)**: `https://charts.helm.sh/stable`
- **Ingress‑nginx**: `https://kubernetes.github.io/ingress-nginx`

Add a repo:
```bash
helm repo add bitnami https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami
helm repo update
```

slides.title: List and Search Charts
slides.codeSnippet:
helm repo list
helm search repo wordpress
# Show chart info:
helm show chart bitnami/wordpress

quizData.question: How do you add a new Helm repository?
quizData.explanation: `helm repo add` followed by `helm repo update`.

slides.title: Chart Values and Customisation ⚙️
slides.content:
## Override defaults

Charts expose a `values.yaml` with default configuration. View them:
```bash
helm show values bitnami/nginx
```

Customize during installation:
- `--set key=value` (e.g., `--set service.type=LoadBalancer`)
- `-f custom-values.yaml` (YAML file)

Values cascade: defaults < parent values < user overrides.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Use `helm search hub` for the Helm Hub

For charts not in your added repos, search the public Helm Hub (Artifact Hub): `helm search hub wordpress`.
